HOUSTON IAH AIRPORT · 96 SUITES

Housekeeping Operations App

One live operational view for front desk, supervisors, housekeepers, and guests.

We built a cloud web app that replaces paper boards, physical master keys, and radio calls with live suite and electronic lock status on the iPads and phones staff already use. Supervisors dispatch suites and monitor floor readiness, housekeepers complete 21-point turnover checklists with deadbolt privacy detection, and guests unlock their doors with digital keys or request service from an in-suite QR card. Every action synchronizes instantly across all devices.

What it does
1
Live room & lock status. Dirty, cleaning in progress, awaiting inspection, clean, maintenance, and privacy deadbolt (DND) for every suite, synced in real time.
2
Assign in bulk & workload. Supervisors assign multiple suites to an attendant with priorities (urgent, high, standard) and balance housekeeping workloads live.
3
Checklists and inspection. A 21-item cleaning checklist with dual QA: housekeepers cannot self-approve; supervisors inspect and log photo-verified tickets.
4
Keyless entry & lock health. Secure BLE unlock matching commercial Onity Trillium mortise locks; staff monitors 4x AA battery pack voltage and signal RSSI.
5
Guest requests by QR. Each suite has a signed QR card. Guests unlock doors and request towels, cleaning, or DND with zero login or app download required.
6
Reports & multi-brand. Cleaning velocity, first-pass QA rates, printable morning shift rosters, and instant multi-brand hotel switching (ESA, Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt).
Keyless Mobile Entry (BLE/RFID) iPad & phone first English / Spanish for staff and guests 3D building board by floor Onity Lock Hardware Telemetry Universal Hotel White-Labeling Role-based staff sign-in Nothing to install, runs in the browser
